result.journal: International Journal of Emerging Technologies in Learning (iJET)
result.keywords: This article examines recent research on mobile learning in special education through a structured content analysis of documents indexed in Scopus. The review focuses on assistive technologies, accessibility, learner engagement, and instructional design patterns used in special education contexts. It also compares sentiment-aware and interaction-based learning tools, summarizing how mobile platforms support personalized learning, communication, and teacher feedback. The study categorizes publications by year, subject area, country/region, and author affiliation, and identifies emerging directions for future work in inclusive digital learning.
result.title: Survey of Mobile Learning Strategies for Assistive Special Education: A Scopus-Based Content Review
